name: request_deployment
description: Request a deployment of a product version carrying the items it ships. Returns the deployment with its id; may_approve says whether you could approve it (the product decides: where a person approves deployments, an agent can only request). Refusals: items: (none, one that targets another product, or one not yet ready), denied:, archived: (an item's project is read-only), Not found. (the product or an item you cannot see).

items.description: The keys of the items this version ships. Each must target the product, and you must be a member of each one's project.

environment.description: Where it goes; production when omitted.

remediates.description: The deployment this one fixes (fix-forward): an earlier deployment of the same product and environment that was verified, failed or rolled back.
